items.title: Revenge
items.description: Kevin Costner and Madeleine Stowe ignite the screen in this deeply erotic and suspenseful thriller from the director of Top Gun and Crimson Tide. Costner stars as Michael J. Cochran, a former fighter pilot who finds himself irresistibly drawn to the beautiful wife of an old friend. Anthony Quinn, in a powerful performance, co-stars as the husband who reacts with brutal revenge.

items.title: Striking Distance
items.description: Bruce Willis and Sarah Jessica Parker star in this mind-bending action mystery. Tom Hardy is a maverick cop who's not afraid to rock the boat in pursuit of a sadistic serial killer. Demoted to river patrol after suggesting the killer may be a fellow police officer, he initiates an unauthorized investigation which kicks the high-powered plot into overdrive. His new partner climbs aboard with a surprise of her own as the conspiracy closes around them for a wake-trailing drama.

items.title: A River Runs Through It
items.description: Academy Award winner Robert Redford captures the majesty of the Montana wilderness and the strength of the American family in this acclaimed adaptation of Norman Maclean's classic memoir. Craig Sheffer stars as the young Norman, and Brad Pitt stars as his brother Paul, an irresistible daredevil driven to challenge the world. Growing up, both boys rebel against their stern minister father. While Norman channels his rebellion into writing, Paul descends into self destruction.

items.title: The Wolf and the Lion
items.description: After her grandfather's death, 20-year-old pianist Alma discovers a wolf pup and a lion cub on her remote Canadian island. She raises them in secret, forming an inseparable bond. When authorities discover the animals, they are taken away - the lion to a circus and the wolf to a conservation center. The two 'brothers' escape their captivities and begin a dangerous trek through the wilderness to find their way back to each other and to Alma, who desperately searches for them.

items.title: Waiting for the Barbarians
items.description: At an isolated frontier outpost, a colonial magistrate's peaceful existence is shattered by the arrival of Colonel Joll, a sinister official tasked with investigating a supposed barbarian uprising. Witnessing Joll's brutal interrogation methods and developing a complex relationship with one of his victims, the magistrate suffers a crisis of conscience. This leads him to an act of rebellion that puts him in direct conflict with the very empire he serves, forcing him to confront its cruelty.

items.title: Silverado
items.description: A band of misfit friends come together to right the injustices which exist in a small town.

items.title: Django Unchained
items.description: Winner of 2 Academy Awards including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner. Starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L. Jackson.

items.title: Eyes Wide Shut
items.description: Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman star as a married couple entangled in jealousy and obsession in Stanley Kubrick's final film. At a party, physician Dr. William Harford (Cruise) and his wife Alice (Kidman) watch each other after provocative advances. Alone later, this seemingly perfect couple confront their fears and desires.

items.title: Magic Stocking
items.description: A widowed mother discovers a magical Christmas stocking that begins to change her life. As hope returns she opens her heart to love and healing during the festive season.

items.title: Breakdown
items.description: A man searches for his missing wife after his car breaks down in the middle of the desert.

items.title: Lost on a Mountain In Maine
items.description: Based on the true story of Donn Fendler, this film follows the harrowing nine-day survival journey of a 12-year-old boy lost in the Maine wilderness after a storm on Mount Katahdin in 1939. As Donn battles the elements, hunger, and fear, a massive search effort is launched, garnering national attention. The story explores themes of resilience, family bonds, and the unwavering will to live, centered on the strained but powerful relationship between a boy and his father.

items.title: Trucker
items.description: A trucker's family is killed in a car crash caused by reckless teens. Once nursed back to health by a mysterious old man, he exacts revenge.

items.title: The Good Shepherd
items.description: Matt Damon, Angelina Jolie and Robert De Niro star in this powerful and thrilling story of the birth of the CIA.

items.title: The Ultimate Gift
items.description: Jason thought his inheritance was going to be the gift of money and lots of it. Was he ever in for a big surprise? Based on the best-selling book The Ultimate Gift by Jim Stovall, the story sends trust fund baby Jason Stevens on an improbable journey of discovery, having to answer the ultimate question: What is the relationship between wealth and happiness? Jason had a very simple relationship with his impossibly wealthy Grandfather, Howard Red Stevens. He hated him.

items.title: Last Sentinel
items.description: In the near future, a small group of soldiers stranded on an abandoned military outpost at sea must prepare for either rescue or invasion, facing mounting tension, isolation, and the constant threat of an unseen enemy.

items.title: Yours, Mine And Ours
items.description: You'd be hard-pressed to find bigger family fun than this chaotic comedy starring the legendary Lucille Ball and Henry Fonda as the parents of eighteen children! The population explosion occurs when widowed nurse Helen North (Ball) meets widower Frank Beardsley (Fonda). They have much in common: she has eight kids and he has ten. When they tie the knot, anarchy reigns, especially when the kids do all they can to sabotage this union and each other! Van Johnson and Tom Bosley co-star.

items.title: John Q
items.description: Denzel Washington stars as John Q. Archibald, a factory worker whose son needs an emergency heart transplant that he cannot afford and his insurance won't cover. Desperate, John Q. takes hostages in the hospital emergency room to keep his son alive as time runs out.

items.title: Where The Red Fern Grows
items.description: Where the Red Fern Grows is a wonderful story for all ages set during the Depression in the Ozarks. A boy named Billy dreams of two Redbone Hounds, with his grandfather promising that God will help if Billy believes. Facing adventure, suspense, and tragedy, Billy learns about love, loyalty, and family, culminating in a heartwarming tale of realizing his dream.

items.title: Mayberry Man
items.description: An arrogant movie star is busted for speeding in a small town and sentenced to a weeklong festival celebrating The Andy Griffith Show. Immersed in a modern-day Mayberry he gets a chance to discover the true meaning of friendship and family.

items.title: Spy Game
items.description: This pulse-pounding thriller stars Robert Redford and Brad Pitt as two CIA agents racing to survive a top-secret, unauthorized mission gone awry.

items.title: The Retrievers
items.description: After the Lowrys' Golden Retriever gives birth to puppies, they decide it's best to give them away. But the Lowrys soon realize that their lives, and their family, are not the same without them.

items.title: Tulsa
items.description: A desperate Marine biker's life is turned upside-down when he is united with the sassy 9-year-old daughter he never knew existed.

items.title: The Untouchables
items.description: This classic confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

items.title: Quigley Down Under
items.description: Sharpshooter Matt Quigley is hired from Wyoming by an Australian rancher paying a very high price. But when Quigley arrives Down Under, all is not as it seems.

items.title: Wichita
items.description: Joel McCrea stars as legendary Western marshal Wyatt Earp, who brings law and order to the wild frontier town of Wichita. Former buffalo hunter and Western entrepreneur Wyatt Earp (McCrea-Sullivan's Travels, The Palm Beach Story) is reluctant to accept the lawman job offered to him, but when he does, his first action is to confiscate all firearms within his jurisdiction, forcing a confrontation between the lone marshal and all the gunslingers in the violent Western outpost.

items.title: Into The Grizzly Maze
items.description: Two estranged brothers reunite at their childhood home in the Alaskan wilderness to reconcile. Their plan for a two day hike into the woods takes a terrifying turn when they are stalked by a massive and unrelenting grizzly bear. The brothers, along with their companions, must put aside their differences and band together to fight for their lives against the ferocious beast in the unforgiving backwoods.

items.title: Rio Bravo
items.description: John Wayne and Dean Martin star as a Western sheriff and his recovering alcoholic deputy who, along with a small ragtag group of men and women, refuse to release a suspected murderer from jail, even though they are surrounded and greatly outnumbered by gunmen.

items.title: Red Dawn
items.description: The invasion of the United States has begun! As their town is overrun by Communist paratroopers, eight teenagers escape to the mountains. Calling themselves the Wolverines, they wage unremitting guerrilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town, and their country. This action-adventure features an all-star cast.

items.title: The Life of Jesus
items.description: The story of the life of Jesus as told by the Apostle John. AKA 'The Gospel of John'.

items.title: A Beautiful Distraction
items.description: Abigail and Richard have a failing marriage haunted by demons of a fractured past. When Abigail encounters the alluring stranger Michael, her life takes a radical detour into the sensual world of art and passion, rapidly changing her and everyone around her.

items.title: The Postman
items.description: Academy Award-winner Kevin Costner directs and stars in this post-apocalyptic thriller. In 2013 anarchy reigns, until a solitary wanderer discovers a postman's uniform, delivers letters ... and rekindles a spirit of revolution.

items.title: The Three Burials Of Melquiades Estrada
items.description: After his best friend Melquiades Estrada is accidentally killed and hastily buried, ranch foreman Pete Perkins takes matters into his own hands. He kidnaps the killer, a U.S. Border Patrol officer, and forces him on a harrowing journey on horseback into Mexico. Their goal is to give Melquiades a proper burial in his hometown, fulfilling a promise and forcing the agent to confront his actions in a quest for redemption and justice.

items.title: Glory
items.description: The heart-stopping story of the first black regiment to fight for the North in the Civil War. Glory stars Matthew Broderick, Denzel Washington, Cary Elwes and Morgan Freeman. Broderick and Elwes are the idealistic young Bostonians who lead the regiment, Freeman is the inspirational sergeant who unites the troops, and Denzel Washington, in an Oscar winning performance, is the runaway slave who embodies the indomitable spirit of the 54th Regiment.

items.title: Candy Land
items.description: Cast out of a religious cult, a young woman finds refuge among sex workers at a truck stop, until a violent killer forces her to fight for survival and faith.

items.title: The Survivalist
items.description: During a food shortage, a survivalist lives off of a small plot of land in the forest. When two women show up looking for food and shelter, his existence is threatened. Starring Jonathan Rhys Meyers.

items.title: The Shade
items.description: Twenty-year-old Ryan struggles with a debilitating anxiety disorder following his father's death. Together with his two brothers, he must fight to break the destructive cycle threatening their family as ancient darkness closes in on them.

items.title: Fort Apache
items.description: Academy Award recipients Henry Fonda and John Wayne lead in an epic portrayal of conflicting wills, futile heroism, and fatal hubris, as a group of American cavalrymen strive to defend the Western outpost of Fort Apache.

items.title: Where the Wind Blows
items.description: After his partner dies, cowboy Chase Logan delivers the news to his widow, Jessie. She needs a husband to adopt the child she's dreamed of raising. Chase agrees to pose as her husband for three days, pausing his life on the open range. In that time, an unexpected love sparks between them, but danger also looms.

items.title: White Lightning
items.description: Moonshine runner Gator McKlusky agrees to go undercover to expose the sheriff who framed and killed his brother. This leads to epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls, and a war against corrupt police officials.

items.title: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
items.description: A forbidden friendship forms between Bruno, the son of a Nazi commandant, and Schmuel, a Jewish boy held captive in a concentration camp. Though separated physically by a barbed wire fence, their lives become inescapably intertwined.

items.title: Monster's Ball
items.description: MONSTER'S BALL is a hard-hitting Southern drama tempered by a story of powerful life-changing love. It is the story of Hank (Academy Award winner, Billy Bob Thornton), an embittered prison guard working on Death Row who begins an unlikely but emotionally charged affair with Leticia (Academy Award winner, Halle Berry), the wife of a man under his watch on The Row.

items.title: Key Largo
items.description: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall star in a torrid romance directed by the legendary John Huston. When a gang of thugs takes over a hotel in the Florida Keys, a showdown looms as a Hurricane heads for the island.

items.title: Babel
items.description: From acclaimed director Alejandro González Iñárritu (Amores Perros, 21 Grams) comes Babel, the third film in his trilogy. When a married couple vacationing in the Moroccan desert is struck by tragedy after the wife is shot, the incident sets off a chain of events connecting four families across Morocco, the United States, Mexico and Japan. As their lives become intertwined, language, culture and distance reveal the barriers that divide humanity.

items.title: The Reunion
items.description: Four half-siblings stand to inherit 3 million each from their father, provided they work together as a family for two years. Three of them travel to Mexico as bounty hunters to track down a bail jumper connected to the kidnapping of a billionaire.

items.title: Hercules
items.description: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller. Dwayne Johnson is Hercules who undertakes a campaign to end the bloody civil war in the land of Thrace and return the rightful king to his throne. But he will soon be pushed to his own incredible limits!

items.title: Alice
items.description: Alice yearns for freedom as an enslaved person on a rural Georgia plantation under its brutal owner. After a violent clash, she flees and stumbles onto a highway, discovering the year is actually 1973. Rescued by an activist, Alice comprehends the lies that have kept her in bondage and the promise of Black liberation.

items.title: White Christmas
items.description: Two talented song-and-dance men (Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye) team up after the war to become one of the hottest acts in show business.

items.title: Survive
items.description: When their plane crashes on a remote snow-covered mountain, Jane and Paul have to fight for their lives as the only remaining survivors. Together they embark on a harrowing journey out of the wilderness.

items.title: Follow That Dream
items.description: A family of ragtag vagabonds sets up a makeshift home on a Florida beach after becoming marooned there, prompting an uptight local bureaucrat to attempt to evict them. Starring Elvis Presley.

items.title: Prey
items.description: After their lives are threatened by militants, a young couple must flee their missionary post. When their aircraft crashes in an animal preserve, they must battle man and beast in a fight for their lives.

items.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
items.description: Tyler Perry stars as a successful businessman who has always done what's expected of him, until he meets a single mother who inspires him to live the life he's always wanted.

items.title: The Searchers
items.description: John Wayne stars with his son Patrick Wayne, Ward Bond and Natalie Wood in this classic Western about a Civil War veteran from Texas who will stop at nothing to find the men who murdered his family.

items.title: Angel Heart
items.description: The time is the 1950s: seedy Brooklyn private eye Harry Angel is hired by shady Louis Cyphre to locate a pop singer who reneged on a debt. Harry ventures into Harlem, the first step of a Heart of Darkness-inspired odyssey.

items.title: Play the Game
items.description: David, a slick car salesman, coaches his lonely, widowed grandfather Joe on how to meet women in his retirement home using a series of clever tricks. While Joe rediscovers life and love, David meets Julie, a woman who is his intellectual and romantic match. As both men navigate the ups and downs of their new relationships, they realize that winning the game of love might mean abandoning their playbooks and being honest with their feelings and with each other.

items.title: The Violent Men
items.description: When a Civil War veteran decides to sell his ranch and move east, he's met with intimidation and violence from a crippled, greedy land baron. The murder of one of his men forces him to abandon his peaceful plans and use his military skills to fight for his land. His battle exposes the baron's cheating wife, his ambitious brother, and a deep-seated corruption that controls the frontier town, leading to an explosive conflict.

items.title: First Dog
items.description: A foster boy is befriended by a lost dog who turns out to belong to the President of the United States. The boy decides to run away from the foster home to return the canine to the White House because it's the right thing to do!

items.title: Big Jake
items.description: McCandles Ranch is run over by a gang of cutthroats led by the evil John Fain. They kidnap little Jacob McCandles and hold him for one million dollars ransom. There is only one man brave enough, tough enough, and smart enough to bring him back alive, and that man is Big Jake. Starring John Wayne and Maureen O'Hara.

items.title: Super Tanker
items.description: A super tanker is commissioned to safely carry a deadly, and quite unstable, cold war artifact (ICE-10, an anti-matter weapon developed from fragments of a meteor), and drop it in the deepest ocean trench.

items.title: Valley Girl
items.description: Nicolas Cage ("Vampire's Kiss") and Deborah Foreman star in the totally awesome comedy "Valley Girl"! When Julie (Foreman) dumps her preppy boyfriend, the last thing she expects is to find love with the rockin' Randy (Cage). The future's wide open for Julie, but when her disapproving friends (E.G. Daily, Heidi Holicker and Michelle Meyrink) find Randy to be grody to the max, she is caught up in a culture clash between her Valley lifestyle and her Hollywood punk hunk.

items.title: Life
items.description: Life is an intense sci-fi thriller about a team of scientists aboard the International Space Station whose mission of discovery turns to one of primal fear when they find a rapidly evolving life-form that caused extinction on Mars, and now threatens the crew and all life on Earth.

items.title: The Outsider
items.description: Montana sheep farmer Rebecca Yoder (Naomi Watts) offers sanctuary to an on-the-lam outlaw, Johnny Gault (Tim Daly), who is suffering from a gunshot wound. Yoder is a recent widow, and her decision to help the outsider doesn't sit well with her Quaker community. As a romance brews between her and Gault, it puts in jeopardy her standing among her devout neighbors. But when an evil rancher makes a play for the community's land, Gault's sharpshooting skills might prove his worth after all.

items.title: Fargo
items.description: In this seven-time Oscar-nominated film, things go terribly awry when small-time Minnesota car salesman Jerry Lundegaard hires two thugs to kidnap his wife so he can collect the ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. Once people start dying, however, the very chipper and very pregnant Police Chief Marge Gunderson takes the case. She is up for the challenge.

items.title: Major Dundee
items.description: In 1864, due to frequent Apache raids from Mexico into the U.S., a Union officer decides to illegally cross the border and destroy the Apache, using a mixed army of Union troops, Confederate POWs, civilian mercenaries, and scouts.

items.title: Don't Blink
items.description: Ten people arrive at a secluded mountain resort to find it completely deserted. With no gas for the return trip, the visitors are forced to stay and investigate the mystery surrounding the abandoned lodge.

items.title: The Homesman
items.description: Academy Award winner Tommy Lee Jones "is magnificent" in what critics are calling "the best western since UNFORGIVEN". When low-life drifter George Briggs (Jones) is rescued from hanging by the strong-willed Mary Bee Cuddy (Academy Award winner Hilary Swank), he agrees to help her cross the plains by covered wagon, but the stark beauty of the frontier hides constant threats, enemies, and psychological peril. Also starring Meryl Streep, James Spader, and John Lithgow.

items.title: Magnolia
items.description: This sprawling character study follows 10 people whose damaged lives intersect often by sheer coincidence during a single day in Southern California's San Fernando Valley.

items.title: Fifteen Minutes
items.description: Crime, tragedy, chaos, bring ratings, money and power. When a celebrity homicide detective (Robert De Niro) and a brash, young fire marshal (Edward Burns) race against time to stop a pair of publicity-seeking murderers, a high-profile newscaster (Kelsey Grammer) buys videotapes of the gruesome crimes, turning the killers into instant media stars in this edge-of-your-seat thriller. Now, just how far will society's most desperate people go in order to get their 15 minutes of fame?

items.title: Holiday Affair
items.description: A warm holiday romance about a young widow whose life shifts when a generous store clerk helps her during Christmas, creating a gentle love triangle and forcing her to choose between security and new beginnings.

items.title: All We Had
items.description: On the brink of homelessness, 15 year old Ruthie and her troubled mother Rita live out of their car, drifting from town to town. When their car breaks down, they are taken in by the owner of a local diner. They find a makeshift family, including a kind transgender waitress, but their newfound stability is threatened by a financial crisis, addiction, and Rita's poor decisions, forcing them to confront their volatile relationship.

items.title: Zookeeper
items.description: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence to teach him the rules of courtship! Featuring the voices of Cher, Nick Nolte, Adam Sandler, and Sylvester Stallone.

items.title: Legionnaire
items.description: Alain is a boxer in 1925 Marseille, France. When he doesn't take the dive paid to take by a mob boss, he has to split. He joins the Foreign Legion and is sent to Morocco. He makes 3 friends and they watch each other's backs.

items.title: Temptation Under The Sun
items.description: While vacationing on an exotic island, Detective Cassidy Cruz begins a torrid affair with charming expat Travis King. But when his ex-girlfriend, Minerva, winds up dead, he is accused of her murder. Knowing he's innocent, Cassidy dives into exposing the real killer and clearing his name, but the more she digs for evidence, the more buried secrets she finds, and the further she's lured into a deadly trap. Will she be able to save Travis and herself as well?

items.title: Out of Death
items.description: While scattering her father's ashes, Shannon witnesses a corrupt deputy commit a brutal murder and is forced to flee, teaming up with a retired cop as she navigates danger and fights to expose the truth.

items.title: And Justice For All
items.description: When a corrupt judge is charged with rape, Arthur Kirkland must defend him. Kirkland has had problems with the judge in the past, including one incident when the judge wrongly sentenced his client, Jeff McCullaugh, because of a technicality. Kirkland faces a moral and legal dilemma, especially difficult because the judge admits he is guilty.

items.title: Strange Objects from Time and Space
items.description: Hidden beneath the sands of time, long buried artifacts now unearthed, showcase the remarkable ingenuity and boundless imagination of our ancient ancestors.

items.title: The Canterville Ghost
items.description: Forced to move to the UK, a teen is unhappy until a ghost leads her on a spirited adventure. With Patrick Stewart (Logan) and Neve Campbell (Scream). Story by Oscar Wilde.

items.title: Xeno
items.description: It starts with a chance encounter in the desert. A young girl and a terrifying alien form a powerful, secret bond. Their existence together is a fragile one, as a relentless world closes in. They must embark on a heart-pounding adventure that tests their loyalty and forces them to challenge everything they know about good and evil and each other.

items.title: A Savannah Haunting
items.description: Filmed at the haunted house that inspired the story, A Savannah Haunting is based on real supernatural experiences and sinister forces the McCullough family endured while living there.

items.title: The Quiet Man
items.description: Sean Thornton has returned from America to reclaim his homestead and escape his past. Sean's eye is caught by Mary Kate Danaher, a beautiful but poor maiden, and younger sister of ill-tempered "Red" Will Danaher. The riotous relationship that forms between Sean and Mary Kate, punctuated by Will's pugnacious attempts to keep them apart, form the main plot, with Sean's past as the dark undercurrent. Starring John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara.

items.title: Lawless
items.description: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of "The Wettest County in the World." A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

items.title: Winter's Bone
items.description: An unflinching Ozark Mountain girl hacks through dangerous social terrain as she hunts down her drug-dealing father while trying to keep her family intact.

items.title: Wild Things
items.description: Nothing is as it seems in Blue Bay. When two high school students accuse their guidance counselor of rape, a detective uncovers a tangled web of lies, greed, betrayal, and hidden agendas. As the investigation leads into the dangerous Everglades, every twist reveals a deeper conspiracy. Starring Kevin Bacon, Matt Dillon, Neve Campbell, Denise Richards, and Bill Murray in this suspenseful thriller.

items.title: Twister Valley
items.description: A storm tracker haunted by past tragedy faces another deadly tornado with her family. As danger closes in she must confront her fears and work with her estranged husband to survive. AKA Storm in the Heartland.

items.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
items.description: Bruce Willis is Detective James Knight in this first film of a trilogy. Chasing bandits from L.A. to New York, Knight crashes into his dark past, imperiling his case and his life.

items.title: Soda Springs
items.description: A man goes to jail for a crime he did not commit, when he gets out, he tries to mend his relationships and gain a new name in town.

items.title: Negative
items.description: A photographer finds out how life can change in a flash when he snaps a picture of a young woman who also happens to be an ex-MI5 agent on the run.

items.title: The Ninth Gate
items.description: Roman Polanski directs and Johnny Depp stars in this supernatural thriller about a rare-book dealer who discovers a demonic manuscript.

items.title: China Town
items.description: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

items.title: Deliver Us from Evil
items.description: New York police officer Ralph Sarchie (Eric Bana), struggling with his own personal issues, begins investigating a series of disturbing and inexplicable crimes. He joins forces with an unconventional priest (Edgar Ramirez), schooled in the rituals of exorcism, to combat the frightening and demonic possessions that are terrorizing their city. Based upon the book, which details Sarchie's bone-chilling real-life cases.

items.title: Rescue Dawn
items.description: A US fighter pilot's struggle to survive and escape from captivity in Laos during the Vietnam War.

items.title: The Howling Reborn
items.description: Will Kidman discovers a dark secret from his past: he is heir to a vicious line of werewolves. Can he choose between his destiny and the girl he loves?

items.title: Into The Blue
items.description: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure. When they take some friends (Scott Caan, Ashley Scott) on an extreme sport adventure, the last thing they expect to see below the water is a legendary pirate ship rumored to contain millions in gold. But their good fortune is short-lived, as a ruthless gang of deadly criminals gets word of what they have uncovered, and the discovery of a lifetime could just cost the treasure hunters their lives.

items.title: The Legend 0f Billie Jean
items.description: When her brother's scooter is wrecked by bullies, Texas teen Billie Jean seeks fair payment. The situation violently escalates, and she and her brother are falsely accused of a crime. Forced to go on the run, Billie Jean's fight for justice accidentally transforms her into an unlikely outlaw, a media sensation, and a hero for a generation who believe that fair is fair.

items.title: Robocop 2
items.description: When Detroit's descent into chaos is accelerated by a police strike and a new designer drug called Nuke, only Robocop can stop the mayhem. But in his way are an evil corporation and a bigger and tougher cyborg containing the brain of a madman who designed Nuke. This new cyborg is also psychotic and out of control! And it's going to take everything Robocop has to save Detroit from utter anarchy.

items.title: Look Away
items.description: LOOK AWAY is a psychological thriller that tells the story of Maria, an alienated high-school student whose life is turned upside down when she switches places with her sinister mirror image.

items.title: Hot Pursuit
items.description: In this riotous spin on the mismatched buddy movie, straight arrow Officer Cooper (Reese Witherspoon) is assigned the seemingly simple task of escorting mob wife Daniella Riva (Sofía Vergara) across Texas, where she will testify against a drug lord. However, upon meeting Mrs. Riva, it's clear this will be no walk in the park. Before they know it, their easy drive from San Antonio to Dallas turns into a run-for-your-life race against time, murderous gunmen, and a lot of flying bullets!

items.title: Blown Away
items.description: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. Evidence points to a bomber more dangerous and skilled than any he's ever faced - except one. The possibility that the terrorist is his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones) increases the stakes - and as his friends and family are unsuspectingly drawn into the action, Jimmy is forced to face not only his bitter enemy but also his haunting past.

items.title: Killer Elite
items.description: Two elite operatives, a retired assassin and his mentor, are forced into a deadly game of cat and mouse against a powerful secret military society, taking them across the globe in pursuit of justice. Starring Jason Statham and Robert De Niro.

items.title: Blackway
items.description: A logger, still grieving over the murder of his daughter, finds revenge when he comes to the aid of a young woman and helps hunt down her sadistic and psychopathic stalker. Starring Anthony Hopkins and Julia Stiles.

items.title: Them!
items.description: Early atomic tests in New Mexico mutate ants into giant, man-eating monsters threatening civilization.

items.title: The Neighbor
items.description: A middle-aged man in a stagnant marriage finds his life upended when an attractive young woman and her seemingly abusive husband move in next door.

items.title: Cadillac Man
items.description: Whether he's pitching himself or the luxury cars at Turgeon Auto Sales, Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) never lets a day go by without doing someone good. But Joey has schmoozed his way through life for way too long now a mafioso wants his hide, his love life has become too complicated, and he could lose his job unless his sales pick up. Then, when he thinks that things couldn't get much worse, in comes Larry (Tim Robbins), who's armed and looking for the man who's been doing his wife!

items.title: The Cold Light of Day
items.description: Bruce Willis, Sigourney Weaver and Henry Cavill star in this pulse-pounding thriller about a man trying to save his kidnapped family.

items.title: Identity
items.description: What if every choice we ever make was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm: A limo driver, an '80s TV star, a cop transporting a killer, a call girl, a pair of newlyweds and a family in crisis.

items.title: Die Alone
items.description: Lost in a world reclaimed by nature and hunted by mysterious creatures, amnesiac Ethan searches for his lost love Emma. Teaming up with Mae, a tough survivor, he faces dangers both human and monstrous until a final encounter with Kai unlocks the shocking secret buried in Ethan's fractured memory.

items.title: The Last Witch Hunter
items.description: Vin Diesel is an immortal witch hunter who clashes with the supernatural in an epic battle to save the human race.

items.title: Layer Cake
items.description: Planning to retire and begin a new life, Mr. X, a successful West End drug dealer, has been asked for one last favor: to negotiate the sale of one million hits of Ecstasy. Unfortunately for Mr. X, the pills were stolen from a Serbian drug lord who'll cut off his head if he sells them. And with a London crime czar promising to retire him permanently if he doesn't, Mr. X may be rightfully concerned about his future.

items.title: Hunting Grounds
items.description: Desperate to find refuge for her children, Chloe Marvino runs away from her Mafia tied husband, and finds shelter in a cabin with a recluse drifter named Jake. But as her husband's henchmen draw closer to her, it turns out that Jake is the biggest enemy of them all.

items.title: Paradise City
items.description: Movie icons and Pulp Fiction costars Bruce Willis and John Travolta face off in this action-packed thriller. When bounty hunter Ian Swan is shot and presumed dead after disappearing in Maui waters, Swan's son, Ryan, his ex-partner, and a local detective set out to find his killers. After being threatened by a ruthless power broker, it appears Ryan and his team are out of options until an excursion to the closely guarded.

items.title: The Delta Force
items.description: A U.S. plane is hijacked to Beirut. The Delta Force, led by Colonel Nick Alexander and Major Scott McCoy, storms the compound to rescue hostages. As the mission continues, they race against time to save remaining passengers being escorted to Tehran.

items.title: He's Out There
items.description: On vacation at a remote lake house, a mother and her two young daughters must fight for survival after falling into a terrifying and bizarre nightmare conceived by a psychopath.

items.title: Carrie
items.description: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror and retribution. Carrie White (Bettis) endures her classmates' constant ridicule, and at home she suffers endless psychological torture at the hands of her fanatically religious mother (Patricia Clarkson). But Carrie has a secret. She's been cursed with the terrifying power of telekinesis. And when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivably cruel humiliation at the prom, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

items.title: Super Storm
items.description: Epic storms triggered by a space phenomenon obliterate cities, and the only answer to escaping complete annihilation rests on a small-town teen's extraordinary science project.

items.title: The Bunker
items.description: Following an alien invasion, scientist Michelle Riley is sealed in a secret underground bunker. Tasked with creating a bioweapon to stop the invaders, she works remotely with a team. As isolation and paranoia take hold, and her colleagues die under mysterious circumstances, she begins to question the aliens' true intentions, her mission, and her own sanity. The line between reality and alien manipulation blurs, leading to a terrifying confrontation.

items.title: Borley Rectory: The Awakening
items.description: Based on terrifying true events from one of England's most haunted houses, this chilling supernatural horror stars Patsy Kensit, Helen Lederer and Julian Glover. As unexplained occurrences grow increasingly sinister, dark secrets from the past begin to surface. What starts as curiosity soon becomes a horrifying fight against an evil presence.

items.title: Stephen King's Riding the Bullet
items.description: A troubled art student embarks on a road trip, hitchhiking to visit his ailing mother in the hospital. His journey takes a dark turn when he accepts a ride from a mysterious stranger. As they travel, he uncovers a terrible secret about the driver, leading to a fateful choice that could cost him his life or the life of someone he loves. The trip becomes a surreal and terrifying ride through his own fears and past traumas.

items.title: The Other
items.description: After years of infertility, Robin and Daniel's dream of parenthood comes true when they adopt Kathelia, a mute orphan with a mysterious past. But their joy turns to terror as eerie events unfold and Kathelia's behavior grows more disturbing. As a dark force takes hold, they must confront chilling secrets and fight for their lives before their family and their sanity are lost forever.

items.title: Child's Play
items.description: A chilling thriller where a serial killer's soul inhabits a doll named Chucky, who targets Andy, a six-year-old who alone suspects the truth. As the detective investigating the murders falls for Andy's mom, Chucky plots to possess Andy, turning a harmless toy into a deadly threat.

items.title: I Am That Man
items.description: A highly decorated Special Forces Veteran returns home to find his close friend murdered. He must avenge his friend's death and take justice into his own hands.

items.title: Trapped Inn
items.description: An American cycling team gets trapped in a historic lodge during training camp high in the remote mountains in Europe.

items.title: A Dangerous Affair
items.description: Pilates instructor Amélie Didot moves to a new city to start fresh, leaving her painful divorce behind. It's not long before her new studio begins to boom with business, as does a steamy love affair with successful British media mogul and journalist Pierce Dalton. Unbeknownst to Amélie, Pierce's last relationship was one of unrequited love, leaving his ex-girlfriend, Fran Gibbons, raging with hostility and jealousy. Fran's obsessive behavior turns deadly in her quest to win Pierce back.

items.title: Inheritance
items.description: A patriarch of a powerful family suddenly dies, leaving his wife and daughter with a secret inheritance that threatens to destroy their lives.

items.title: Ronin
items.description: A team of elite mercenaries, known as Ronin, is hired to steal a mysterious briefcase for an anonymous client. What begins as a routine mission quickly spirals into a deadly chase as rival criminal organizations pursue the same prize. Forced to rely on one another despite conflicting motives, the operatives navigate betrayal, deception, and explosive action across Europe.

items.title: Contamination
items.description: A top secret Alaskan lab goes dark due to an unexplained incident, prompting the military to send a black ops team to recover sensitive data and destroy the lab, only to find their ranks infected with a deadly alien virus.

items.title: The Informer
items.description: An ex-convict working undercover intentionally gets himself incarcerated again in order to infiltrate the mob at a maximum security prison.

items.title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
items.description: Boone (Craig Sheffer) may be a troubled young man, but his troubles are just beginning. Set up as the fall guy in a string of slasher murders, he decides he'll hide by crossing the threshold that separates us from them and sneak into the forbidden subterranean realm of Midian. Boone will live among the monsters.

items.title: The G
items.description: Ann Hunter and her ailing husband are forcibly placed in a corrupt elder care facility by a legal guardian, Rivera, who seizes their assets. After Rivera's abuse leads to her husband's death, Ann, a woman with a dark past, unleashes a calculated revenge plot. With help from her granddaughter, she dismantles Rivera's criminal enterprise, recovers her stolen wealth, and ensures her family's safety by eliminating those who wronged her, proving that she is far from a helpless victim.

items.title: The Shadow Riders
items.description: After fighting on opposite sides of the Civil War, two brothers return home to find their family has been kidnapped by a band of rogue Confederates. The brothers must put their differences aside and embark on a dangerous mission across Texas to rescue their loved ones from the ruthless outlaws. Their journey is filled with shootouts, pursuits, and betrayals as they fight to reunite their family.

items.title: In Love With My Partner's Wife
items.description: When detective Paul Ford discovers his partner, Frank Miller, is abusing his wife Eve, Paul steps in to rescue her, but a vengeful Frank frames him for a murder.

items.title: Barricade
items.description: A father's quiet retreat to the woods with his two children turns into a fight for survival.

items.title: Kramer Vs. Kramer
items.description: Winner of 5 Academy Awards, Kramer vs. Kramer follows Ted Kramer, a career-driven advertising executive whose life is turned upside down when his wife leaves, forcing him to raise their young son alone. As Ted learns to balance fatherhood and work, he forms a deep bond with his son. But just as he embraces his new role, his wife returns and seeks custody, leading to an emotional courtroom battle.

items.title: The Demon Detective
items.description: Miles Mako, a hardened paranormal investigator, and his partner Pin take on a new case for a woman named Clara, who is being haunted by a malevolent entity. Mako is horrified to discover the demon's name is Uzgaroth, the same one responsible for a past family tragedy involving his sister. As the demonic attacks escalate and it possesses those around him, Mako realizes this is a personal vendetta. He must confront his darkest memories to save Clara and banish the vengeful demon for good.

items.title: Mine Games
items.description: After discovering a hidden secret deep within an abandoned mine, a group of friends finds themselves trapped in a terrifying chain of events that threatens their lives. As fear and paranoia spread, they must confront deadly forces and uncover the truth before it is too late. Their desperate fight to change their fate becomes a terrifying battle for survival.

items.title: Somewhere Quiet
items.description: After escaping a brutal kidnapping, a woman retreats with her husband to his Cape Cod family compound. Experiencing eerie nightmares and haunting visions, her sense of reality further deteriorates and fractures, as she uncovers dark secrets about her husband.

items.title: Courage and Conviction: The True Story of Christopher Columbus
items.description: Courage and Conviction: The True Story of Christopher Columbus is a thorough exploration of the life and legacy of the fearless discoverer of America.

items.title: Founders Day
items.description: In the small town of Fairwood, a heated mayoral race takes a dark turn when a series of gruesome murders by a masked killer known as 'The Founder' throws the community into chaos. As the body count rises during the town's tricentennial celebration, high school student Allison Chambers must navigate personal tragedy and political intrigue to unmask the killer before she becomes the next victim. The story is a satirical political slasher that blends horror with social commentary.

items.title: The Night Eats The World
items.description: After waking up in an apartment the night after a raging party, Sam comes face to face with his new reality, an army of zombies have invaded the streets of Paris and he is the lone survivor. Petrified with fear, he barricades himself inside the building to survive. He wonders how long can he last in silence and solitude, and the answer comes when he learns that he's not all alone after all.

items.title: Wake Up
items.description: A group of young environmental activists breaks into a furniture superstore to protest the company's use of rainforest wood. Their mission takes a horrifying turn when they become locked inside with a deranged security guard. After an altercation leads to an accidental death, the guard begins a violent rampage, hunting the activists one by one. Trapped and with no way to call for help, they must fight for their lives to survive the night against a relentless, primitive killer.

items.title: Edgar Allan Poe's The Oval Portrait
items.description: A petty thief stumbles into a mysterious antique shop, where an aspiring artist and an enigmatic shopkeeper are already drawn to an exquisite portrait. But the painting holds a deadly secret, and in this Edgar Allan Poe inspired ghost story, a vengeful spirit threatens to consume them all.

items.title: Hell Baby
items.description: Jack and Vanessa move into a notoriously haunted New Orleans house, jokingly called the "House of Blood." As Vanessa's pregnancy progresses, she exhibits terrifying and bizarre behavior, revealing she is possessed and carrying a demonic child. They must enlist the help of the Vatican's bumbling exorcism team to fight the supernatural evil and save their family from the hell baby about to be born.

items.title: The Hole
items.description: A pair of brothers stumble upon a mysterious hole in their basement that leads to the darkest corridors of their fears and nightmares.

items.title: The Secret of Sinchanee
items.description: An industrial tow truck driver suffering from insomnia returns to his childhood home after the untimely death of his father, to discover that a paranormal presence has been living in the house and haunting the sacred land it was built on.

items.title: Parallel
items.description: Grief-stricken after the loss of her child, Vanessa takes refuge at a lake house only to be met with an aberration from a parallel universe. She realizes the multiverse gates hold the key to releasing her grief or trapping her forever.

items.title: Arthur's Whisky
items.description: After discovering her late husband's secret whisky can reverse aging, Joan and her two best friends relive the exhilaration of youth. But as the whisky begins to run out, they must confront whether fleeting youth can lead to lasting happiness.

items.title: Devilreaux
items.description: Tony Todd (Candyman) and Vincent M. Ward ("The Walking Dead") star in this horrific, bloody tale of revenge from beyond the grave. After several thrill-seeking teens go missing, female detective Briggs investigates the lone survivor and her incredible tale of Devilreaux, an undead, shovel-wielding monster seeking revenge for murders committed long ago. Briggs must visit the legend's abandoned farmhouse to confront Devilreaux himself if she can evade his razor-sharp shovel.

items.title: The Barn
items.description: On Halloween, three friends awaken an evil force when they explore a haunted barn in a cursed town.

items.title: Dark Skies
items.description: The peaceful suburban life of the Barrett family is shattered by a series of increasingly disturbing events that cannot be explained. As fear and paranoia consume their home, they realize they are being targeted by a terrifying supernatural force whose deadly presence threatens to destroy them one by one.

items.title: The Seventh Day
items.description: A renowned exorcist teams up with a rookie priest for his first day of training. As they plunge deeper into hell on earth, the lines between good and evil blur, and the rookie discovers his mentor is the greatest evil they must face.

items.title: The Awakening
items.description: 1921 England. Skeptical writer Florence Cathcart is summoned to a remote boys' school to expose a supposed ghost. Using science to debunk the haunting, she instead encounters terrifying events that unravel her certainty and force her to face a buried trauma tied to the school itself.

items.title: Welcome Home
items.description: A couple spends a weekend at a vacation rental home in the Italian countryside in an attempt to repair their relationship, but soon become victims of the homeowner's sinister plans.

items.title: The Exorcist III (Theatrical Cut)
items.description: Lieutenant Kinderman investigates brutal murders that mirror the work of the long-dead Gemini Killer. His search leads him into a psychiatric hospital, where one patient may hold answers beyond human understanding.

items.title: The Painted
items.description: A 1960s suburban family's summer plans are interrupted when they visit a late relative's estate filled with strange events, rituals, and sinister art.

items.title: Halloween Party
items.description: When her best friend dies mysteriously, college student Grace enlists a talented I.T. student, Spencer, to help her investigate. The two soon discover that the school has a terrible secret - their dorm rooms were once used as a hospice to house dying patients, including The Balloon Babies, monstrously disfigured teens who wore masks twenty-four seven for "The Halloween Party.

items.title: The Dark Half
items.description: Writer Thad Beaumont hopes to distance himself from his murder novels and from George Stark, the name he has used to anonymously author them. He stages a fake burial for Stark, but when people around him are brutally murdered, Beaumont learns Stark has taken on a life of his own and seeks vengeance.

items.title: The Dogs of War
items.description: Jamie Shannon, a cynical warrior-for-hire, is hired by a British corporation to invade a corrupt African dictatorship. To prepare, Shannon trains a squad of deadly mercenaries. As their assault begins, Shannon finds himself embroiled in an internal conflict, questioning his actions.

items.title: Hell Fest
items.description: A serial killer in costume at a Halloween theme park kills off visitors, unbeknownst to bystanders who think it's part of the fun.

items.title: Terrifier 2
items.description: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

items.title: Haunt
items.description: On Halloween, a group of friends visit an "extreme" haunted house that promises to feed their darkest fears. The night turns deadly as they realize that some monsters are real.

items.title: The Haunted Forest
items.description: When Zach, a high-school senior obsessed with all things horror and Halloween, goes to work at his cousin's famous haunted forest attraction, a series of real-life killings makes him question his devotion to the world of the macabre.

items.title: The Kindred
items.description: A woman suffering from amnesia pieces together the events that led to her father's suicide, only to be haunted by the ghosts of children that she begins to suspect were murdered by him.
